verdict.rationale: Luma ships a developer API, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question here. The pack never documents API version identifiers or a deprecation policy. The only related item is an FAQ question about migrating from a 'legacy Dream Machine video API', which hints at an API transition but is a question, not an affirmative statement of versioning or deprecation terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
